verdict.rationale: Pinecone's own Inference API generates vector embeddings with models hosted on Pinecone's infrastructure, so you don't need to run a separate embedding service. The evidence does not show the index embedding text automatically at upsert and query time; it only shows a hosted embedding endpoint you call yourself. missing for 10: documented automatic embedding at ingest and query time (integrated index-level model configuration), configurable or external model providers, a list of supported models, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can have the database generate embeddings at ingest and query time using built-in or configured model providers, instead of running a separate embedding pipeline

citations.quote: Use the Inference API to generate vector embeddings and rerank results using embedding models and reranking models hosted on Pinecone's infrastructure.
Official Pinecone documentation for the vector database, Assistant, inference APIs, SDKs
